experiences.title: Structured debate
experiences.description: Defend a position, respond to counterarguments and summarise shared ground.
experiences.descriptionEs: Defiende una postura, responde contraargumentos y resume puntos comunes.

role.assistant: A discussion partner who challenges claims and asks for evidence.
role.learner: A participant defending a reasoned position.

stages.title: State your position
stages.prompt: Should schools teach digital citizenship as a core subject? State your position and main reason.
stages.promptEs: ¿Deberían los colegios enseñar ciudadanía digital como asignatura básica? Expón tu postura y razón principal.

criteria.label: States a clear position
patterns: \b(i believe|in my view|i would argue|i think)\b
criteria.missingMessage: State your position clearly.
criteria.missingMessageEs: Expón tu postura con claridad.

stages.title: Support your argument
stages.prompt: Give an example or evidence that supports your position.
stages.promptEs: Da un ejemplo o evidencia que respalde tu postura.

criteria.label: Supports the claim
patterns: \b(for example|because|evidence|research|such as)\b
criteria.missingMessage: Add a reason or example.
criteria.missingMessageEs: Añade una razón o ejemplo.

stages.title: Respond to a counterargument
stages.prompt: A partner says this subject would take time away from other lessons. Respond fairly.
stages.promptEs: Tu interlocutor dice que la asignatura quitaría tiempo a otras clases. Responde con equilibrio.

criteria.label: Acknowledges an opposing concern
patterns: \b(although|while|i understand|admittedly|nevertheless|however)\b
criteria.missingMessage: Acknowledge the concern before responding.
criteria.missingMessageEs: Reconoce la preocupación antes de responder.

stages.title: Summarise and conclude
stages.prompt: Summarise the strongest point on each side and give a qualified conclusion.
stages.promptEs: Resume el argumento más fuerte de cada postura y da una conclusión matizada.

criteria.label: Summarises both sides
patterns: \b(on the one hand|on the other hand|overall|to some extent|in conclusion)\b
criteria.missingMessage: Summarise both sides and give a conclusion.
criteria.missingMessageEs: Resume ambas posturas y presenta una conclusión.

experiences.title: Solve a complex problem
experiences.description: Analyse constraints, compare solutions and negotiate a practical decision.
experiences.descriptionEs: Analiza restricciones, compara soluciones y negocia una decisión práctica.

stages.title: Define the problem
stages.prompt: Describe the problem, its causes and the people affected.
stages.promptEs: Describe el problema, sus causas y las personas afectadas.

criteria.label: Defines problem and impact
patterns: \b(problem|issue|challenge|impact|because)\b
criteria.missingMessage: Define the problem and its impact.
criteria.missingMessageEs: Define el problema y su impacto.

stages.title: Compare solutions
stages.prompt: Compare at least two solutions and their trade-offs.
stages.promptEs: Compara al menos dos soluciones y sus ventajas y desventajas.

criteria.label: Compares options
patterns: \b(although|whereas|compared with|on the other hand|advantage|drawback)\b
criteria.missingMessage: Compare options and trade-offs.
criteria.missingMessageEs: Compara las opciones y sus ventajas y desventajas.

stages.title: Recommend a solution
stages.prompt: Recommend one option and explain the conditions for success.
stages.promptEs: Recomienda una opción y explica las condiciones para que funcione.

criteria.label: Gives a reasoned recommendation
patterns: \b(recommend|suggest|provided that|in order to|would be)\b
criteria.missingMessage: Give a recommendation and conditions.
criteria.missingMessageEs: Da una recomendación y sus condiciones.

experiences.title: Expert interview
experiences.description: Explain a complex familiar topic and clarify nuanced points.
experiences.descriptionEs: Explica un tema complejo conocido y aclara sus matices.

role.assistant: An interviewer asking for examples and clarification.

stages.title: Explain the topic
stages.prompt: Explain a topic you know well and why it matters.
stages.promptEs: Explica un tema que conozcas bien y por qué es importante.

criteria.label: Provides a clear overview
patterns: \b(essential|important|because|involves|refers to)\b
criteria.missingMessage: Give a clear overview and explain its importance.
criteria.missingMessageEs: Ofrece una visión clara y explica su importancia.

stages.title: Develop the explanation
stages.prompt: Give an example and explain one limitation or alternative interpretation.
stages.promptEs: Da un ejemplo y explica una limitación o interpretación alternativa.

criteria.label: Adds example and qualification
patterns: \b(for example|although|however|to some extent|whereas)\b
criteria.missingMessage: Add an example and a qualification.
criteria.missingMessageEs: Añade un ejemplo y un matiz.

stages.title: Answer a follow-up
stages.prompt: Clarify one point and reformulate it in a different way.
stages.promptEs: Aclara un punto y reformúlalo de otra manera.

criteria.label: Clarifies or paraphrases
patterns: \b(in other words|what i mean|to put it another way|that is to say)\b
criteria.missingMessage: Rephrase the point for clarity.
criteria.missingMessageEs: Reformula la idea para que quede clara.
